title: confed clone result
description: The `result` of `confed clone --json`. For one space: the init result and the first pull's outcome, side by side. With `--all`: one entry per space.

all.description: `confed clone --all`. The exit code is 8 when any space failed.

root.description: The folder each space was cloned into, as <root>/<KEY>.

spaces.description: Every space taken, ordered by key, then any --include key the server did not list.

status.description: `cloned`: new folder, pulled. `pulled`: already cloned, pulled because of --pull. `skipped`: already cloned, left as it was. `failed`: see `error`.

pages.description: Pages in the workspace afterwards; null when the space failed.

error.description: Why the space failed, with what to do about it.

code.description: The failure's error code, as in the envelope's `errors`.
